fn gcd(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a > 0)
  requires (b >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (b == 0) then a else gcd(b, (a % b))))
  ensures (result > 0)
  effects pure
  example (gcd(1, 0) == 1)
  example (gcd(2, 0) == 2)
{
  if (b == 0) then a else gcd(b, (a % b))
}

fn countDistinctPrimeFactors(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n > 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 1) then 0 else countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(n, 2)))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (countDistinctPrimeFactors(1) == 0)
  example (countDistinctPrimeFactors(2) == 1)
{
  if (n == 1) then 0 else countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(n, 2)
}

fn countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(n: Int, i: Int) -> Int
  requires (n > 0)
  requires (i >= 2)
  ensures (result == (if ((i * i) > n) then if (n > 1) then 1 else 0 else if ((n % i) == 0) then (1 + countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(divideOutFactor(n, i), (i + 1))) else countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(n, (i + 1))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(1, 2) == 0)
  example (countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(2, 2) == 1)
{
  if ((i * i) > n) then if (n > 1) then 1 else 0 else if ((n % i) == 0) then (1 + countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(divideOutFactor(n, i), (i + 1))) else countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(n, (i + 1))
}

fn divideOutFactor(n: Int, factor: Int) -> Int
  requires (n > 0)
  requires (factor > 1)
  requires ((n % factor) == 0)
  ensures (result == (if (((n / factor) % factor) == 0) then divideOutFactor((n / factor), factor) else (n / factor)))
  ensures (result > 0)
  ensures (result < n)
  ensures ((result % factor) != 0)
  effects pure
  example (divideOutFactor(2, 2) == 1)
  example (divideOutFactor(10, 2) == 5)
{
  if (((n / factor) % factor) == 0) then divideOutFactor((n / factor), factor) else (n / factor)
}

fn solve(A: Int, B: Int) -> Int
  requires (A > 0)
  requires (B > 0)
  ensures (result > 0)
  ensures (result == (countDistinctPrimeFactors(gcd(A, B)) + 1))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == 0)
